channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Judge orders halt to controversial Pacific Beach ADU project
item.description: A California Superior Court judge has granted a preliminary injunction on a 136-unit ADU project in Pacific Beach, pausing construction and marking a step forward for concerned residents.

item.title: California ends Medicaid coverage of weight loss drugs
item.description: Low-income Californians who use GLP-1s for weight loss lost their coverage at the start of the new year, with officials advising diet and exercise instead.

item.title: Newsom budget gives schools, community colleges unexpected $22 billion boost
item.description: The biggest surprise in the state budget is an unanticipated increase in funding for TK-12 and community colleges.

item.title: Thousands of San Diegans turn out for protests against ICE violence
item.description: Most of the locations drew hundreds, but even one in Julian saw at least 42 people protesting the shooting.

item.title: Start 2026 with a purpose: Volunteer at Mission Trails Regional Park
item.description: With more than 8,000 acres of open space, miles of trails, and wildlife galore, Mission Trails is one of San Diego’s most treasured spaces.

item.title: Huge crowds crawling around tide pools cause concern in La Jolla
item.description: The low tides led to numerous transgressions of what might be termed proper “tide pool protocol" by beachgoing tourists.

item.title: Farmers Insurance is leaving, but Torrey Pines tournament will continue
item.description: The PGA Tour announced on Jan. 9 that after a 16-year run, this is the final year with Farmers as the event's title sponsor.

item.title: Former Poway councilman Tony Blain pleads not guilty to perjury, bribery charges
item.description: Former Poway City Councilman Tony Blain, who was set to be removed from his seat by voters last fall following allegations of vote trading and clashes with his colleagues, pleaded not guilty Monday to criminal charges that include perjury and soliciting bribes.

item.title: San Diego County mayors join push to repeal paid parking at Balboa Park
item.description: Mayors and elected officials from across the county stepped into a city of San Diego policy fight Monday, opposing the city’s newly implemented paid parking program at Balboa Park and backing a proposed ordinance that would permanently repeal the fees.

item.title: Ex-San Diego Navy sailor sentenced for selling military secrets to China
item.description: A former San Diego-based U.S. Navy sailor convicted of selling military secrets to a Chinese intelligence officer was sentenced Monday to over 16 years in prison.
